news.title: Joint venture of OKX and NYSE parent ICE files for 24/7 tokenized U.S. stock trading
news.summary: OKXICE, the joint venture of OKX and ICE, plans to launch tokenized U.S. stocks under SEC's new innovation exemption.

news.title: Zcash’s 25-second blocks go live on public testnet ahead of schedule
news.summary: NU7 cuts the target block time from 75 seconds to 25, giving exchanges, wallets and developers a live rehearsal before a planned November mainnet launch.

news.title: Bitcoin zooms toward $87,000, nearly setting an eight-month high, then reverses
news.summary: Bitcoin came within about $500 of its late-September peak before sellers pushed it back under $86,000. It's the second rally in a week to stall.
